source.title: Culmination
source.description: Once we begin the ritual, I can't be sure what will happen. This place is crawling with demons and if they detect our ritual, we may need to defend ourselves. You and Ada will need to focus on that while I channel the spell. Please stay close however, as you yourself are a vital part of this magic.
source.objective: Defend Gregory as he completes the ritual to destroy the Mannoroc Echoing Orb.
source.completion:
No... no. This cannot be! We were so close!

I have failed my mission. Azgaloth is unleashed. We need to regroup and plan our next steps.
